posts.author: HoneyShadeStudios
posts.body: Hi, so we are new at making RPGs (which will be obvious by this post). So my sister and I are trying to make a game, and I cannot for the life of me figure out how to make a dialogue change. We have been coding it using Conditional Branches and Else Events, making the NPC give the MC an item so that the dialogue would cease out of context using things like "If player has newspaper: (dialogue) Else: (dialogue). If there is a way to do this that does not involve the NPC giving the MC an item, PLEASE let me know. We need multiple dialogue sequences with the same character to get the story going and not have the same dialogue every single time the player sees the same person. A lot of NPCs are important for understanding the story.  Thank you!!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
If you and your sister are brand new to RPG Maker, I'd suggest making sure you do the built-in tutorial and also recreate some other YouTube tutorials to really learn how MV works. There are a TON of content creators who made entire tutorial series for MV.
I'm not exactly sure what you are specifically asking for, but the first 7 tutorials on my YouTube playlist for RPG Maker MZ tutorials cover different options for dialog with NPCs. Including how to not repeat dialog and advancing Event pages.
Since MV and MZ are mostly the same, everything in the tutorials should apply to MV as well. So, most MZ tutorials work perfectly fine for MV.
Maybe these will give you some ideas or cover what you are looking for.
Anyway, here is a link to the playlist.
For future reference, it is usually very helpful to post screenshots of whatever events you are working with so we can see what you have already tried and how we might better assist.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
